description: This is the main entry point widget for the Flutter e-commerce app, defining the primary scaffold with app bar, bottom navigation, and page transitions. It manages navigation between core screens such as Home, Discover, Bookmark, Cart, and Profile, and includes UI elements like icons, theme-based styling, and page animations.

classes.name: EntryPoint
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main entry widget which manages the primary navigation and layout for the app.

classes.name: _EntryPointState
classes.description: State class for EntryPoint, handles current page index, builds UI with app bar, bottom navigation, and page transition logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including AppBar, body with page transition, and BottomNavigationBar with icons and navigation logic.

methods.name: svgIcon
methods.description: Helper function to load SVG icons with optional color filter and fixed size.
